nina: ok new low-stakes tradition: model horoscopes. who wants to write one for miso-0.9? :crystal_ball:
omar: i'll do it. miso-0.9 is a Libra: indecisive clarifier, loves balanced prompts and dramatic apologies.
felix: please include a compatibility chart with coffee types.
design-bot: reminder: keep images SFW and emoji-friendly if posting to #design-memes.
nina: horoscope draft incoming
nina: ```
Miso-0.9 (Libra)
Today miso will weigh your input carefully before offering a charmingly ambiguous suggestion. Expect 2 clarifying questions, 1 gentle rephrase, and an existential aside about token budgets. Avoid asking it to summarize meeting notes at 2am. Good luck.
Lucky tokens: --help, /summarize, :pretzel:
Compatibility: cold brew (70%), oat latte (20%), instant coffee (10%)
```
omar: this is peak culture. also can we make a tarot deck for models? like "The Overfit", "The Optimizer", "The Dropout".
felix: love it. "The Overfit" reversed = it's fine, it's fine, it's not fine.
ops-bot: poll created: "Tarot card to design first" Options: The Overfit, The Optimizer, The Dropout
omar: voted The Optimizer
felix: voted The Dropout (dramatic)
nina: voted The Overfit (for emotional closure)
design-bot: i'll mock up card backs tonight. color palette suggestion: gradient warm->cool, with tiny tensor motifs.
omar: can we also get tiny fortune cookies that contain one-liners from the models? e.g., "I think you mean --clarify"
felix: giveaway idea: 100 mini cards + cookies at next all-hands. merch budget permitting.
ops-bot: poll closed. Results: The Optimizer 45%, The Dropout 33%, The Overfit 22%.
nina: next step: someone write card copy for The Optimizer. short bullet lines only.
design-bot: i'll queue a brief in #design with sizes and font suggestions. also pinging @design for art.
felix: i'll draft 6 one-liners for the fortune cookies and post in a thread.
omar: agreement: no actual tarot readings before releases. superstition level: low, vibes: high. :four_leaf_clover:
